_notes: C6 - Sub-crew ('tables') capture, office half (catalog C6, plan test-plans/journey-c/c06-sub-crew-tables-capture.md, runner row C6). dayOffset -10 is Journey C's own fixture day, distinct from Journey B's 0...-9 block, so the two suites never collide on the same day's cards.

table.source 'fixture' targets the fixed 'C6 TABLE A' row from src/data/journey-c/fixture.json, ensured on screen (Setup > Table) when missing and never deleted: GET /crew-tables/{id} answers 500 on dev (mssql: Invalid object name 'ct.TimeStamp'), so DELETE has no rowversion to send and a run-unique table would leak one row per run.

The capture clocks all four members (7002-7005) in on Crew Time In with no table, then clocks the three fixture table workers (7002-7004) out with the table selected and the fixture supervisor (7005) out with no table, so the roll-up partitions a non-trivial 3 on-table + 1 off-table = 4, not a trivial 3 = 3 / 0 off.
WEBPET-3734 (web-pet #1526, merged 2026-10-28) removed the Table picker from Crew Time In; the table is captured on Crew Time Out, and Table / Crew are read back from the Crew Time Out edit pages.

annotations.description: Report by table / roll up to crew: reports are not on the web yet (PET-12682); the roll-up is asserted from the four Crew Time Out edit pages (Table / Crew), the View > Time Cards employee per card, and the crew's row count on View > Time Cards.

Kiosk capture is device-only; the office receives the punches, entered here on Input > Batch > Crew Time In (no table) and Crew Time Out (the table). The table is ensured on screen (Setup > Table) when missing; that is a precondition, not the workflow.

Pieces by table: the catalog's step 2 is 'capture time AND pieces by table' and only time is covered. The suite has no crew piece-out table helper and the Crew Piece Out form has never been explored live.
